source_snapshot.procedure: During Test is literally `TBD`; no target channel, responder, encapsulated frame, tracking/security mode or acceptance is supplied. Before Test generically says to clear logs, which would destroy delivery evidence.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO correctly refuses to fabricate an externally visible message.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: BLOCKED correctly requires a single authorized destination, benign payload, delivery evidence, cleanup and no retry, but incorrectly treats the standard App 0x34 control/response schema as vendor-defined.

old_problem: The historical record retained Pending/BLOCKED because Master Procedure and Criteria are TBD and arbitrary destination/payload choices could trigger consumers. IPMI v2.0 sections 6.13 and 22.7 define App 0x34, target channel, tracking/raw/security bits, protocol-specific encapsulated message formats and completion behavior. Exact topology, one harmless responder/request and security policy can be Project-bound without guessing OEM commands.
disposition_reason: Preserve the Master TBD and actual Send Message side effect. Compile one protocol-valid, non-broadcast, read-only request such as Get Device ID for one Project-approved isolated responder on one authoritative channel, select tracking/security bits exactly for the source/target relationship, send once via standard App 0x34, and distinguish immediate bridge completion from the later responder result. Correlate the remote response through the separately approved Get Message path or independent target audit. Never use raw-send, a state-changing payload, unknown session, production consumer, broad destination, log clear or automatic retry.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1008, same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT V2, tests JSON, selection manifest, historical V3.1 record and adjacent row 1009 were directly reviewed; next pending was verified as Functionality row 1009 / variant c71d8b61c600745a.

IPMI v2.0 section 22.7 and Table 22-9 define App 0x34 request byte 1: tracking mode in bits 7:6, encryption/authentication requirements in bits 5/4 and target channel in bits 3:0; bytes 2:N carry target-protocol message data.

No Tracking is the normal system-interface-to-other-media mode. Track Request is for non-SMS source channels so BMC can route a later response; optional Send Raw bypasses IPMI parsing and is excluded from this safe functional case.

Table 22-10 defines address/session/checksum framing by target medium/protocol. Invalid session, lost arbitration, bus error and NAK have distinct completion codes; a generic payload cannot be reused across channels.

Section 6.13.2 states the immediate Send Message response only confirms the bridge action, not success of the encapsulated remote request. End-to-end PASS therefore requires a correlated responder result or authoritative consumer audit.

ED-03, ED-15 through ED-19, ED-24 and ED-26 through ED-30 permit a standard, parameterized single-target message under explicit approval; ED-33 through ED-38 preserve TBD history and forbid broadcast, unsafe substitution, log deletion or retry.

test_case.test_name: Bridge one approved read-only IPMI request to one isolated responder and verify the correlated response
test_case.purpose: Verify standard Send Message correctly bridges one protocol-valid, benign read-only request from the active system interface to one approved responder/channel, reports bridge status, produces the expected responder result and leaves routing, queues, logs and all non-target devices healthy.
required_package: Immutable DUT/BMC/system-interface identity, firmware version, pinned ipmitool/raw collector and protected App 0x34 protocol encoder/decoder
Authoritative topology mapping exact numeric channel to medium/protocol and one non-broadcast responder address/session; vendor definition for any OEM medium

Versioned message contract: source type, no-tracking or tracking rationale, auth/encryption policy, exact read-only command and data, requester/responder LUN/address, unique sequence/correlation and checksum/PEC rules
Approved isolated responder or simulator whose selected request is harmless and whose expected response is authoritative; no production actuator/alert/power/flash/reset/clear target
Separately approved Get Message/consumer-audit evidence path, queue/routing/BMC health limits, point-of-action approval, no-retry rule and unintended-delivery incident runbook
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED HYBRID PROCEDURE ONLY; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Bind one channel `<ch>` and one non-broadcast isolated responder from authoritative topology; verify medium/protocol and target identity independently. Select one Project-approved read-only benign request (default recommendation: standard Get Device ID where supported), unique sequence/correlation and expected response. Have the pinned encoder generate and peer-check the exact Table 22-10 frame, addresses/LUNs, length and checksum/PEC. For a system-interface source, normally use No Tracking 00b; do not choose Track Request unless the documented source/target model requires it. Set authentication/encryption requirement bits only from the channel security policy; never silently downgrade. Preserve channel/routing/queue/log/health baselines and show the exact `ipmitool raw 0x06 0x34 <control-byte> <protocol-frame-bytes...>` with decoded meaning, target and inverse containment; obtain immediate confirmation. Send once. Capture the immediate completion, recognizing 00h proves bridge delivery only. Correlate the responder response by unique sequence/command/address using the separately approved one-message Get Message case, or use an authoritative isolated-consumer audit when queue retrieval is not applicable. Compare target and non-target audit/health, preserve logs, and stop. Never use broadcast/all addresses, Send Raw 10b, reserved 11b, state-changing/OEM payload, production session, generic log clear, repeated traffic or retry after ambiguity.
test_case.expected_result: One exact 0x34 request is accepted and bridged to only the approved responder/channel, the protocol frame/security mode is valid, and a separately captured responder result matches the unique correlation and authoritative expected read-only response. No non-target consumer acts, no unexpected message/alert occurs, queues and BMC/management health remain within approved limits, and preserved routing/log state is unchanged.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires authoritative target/channel mapping, exact decoded benign frame, immediate approval, one send, valid bridge completion, correlated end-to-end responder success, unchanged non-target state and intact audit/health. Immediate 00h alone cannot pass. Invalid session 80h, arbitration 81h, bus 82h, NAK 83h, unexpected target/action, missing response, malformed checksum/PEC, unapproved security downgrade, raw/broadcast/state-changing payload, absent limits, log clear, retry or cleanup failure is FAIL/BLOCKED as appropriate. Missing runtime binding is NOT READY rather than Engineering Decision Pending.
safety_gate: Require point-of-action confirmation after displaying exact channel, target address/session, tracking/security bits, decoded read-only payload, expected remote response, one-message limit and containment plan.
Use only one authoritative non-broadcast isolated responder. Never target a production actuator, alert handler, power/reset/flash/firmware/SEL-clear command or unverified OEM consumer.
Forbid optional Send Raw and reserved tracking mode. Use the protocol format, address/LUN, sequence, checksum/PEC and session handle required by the exact channel.
Do not clear logs or queues. If response collection consumes one queue message, apply the separately approved Get Message evidence-preservation gate.
Monitor BMC/interface/queue/alerts and target/non-target audit independently; stop and isolate the test path on any unexpected delivery, action or degradation.
No automatic retry after timeout or uncertain completion because the target may already have received and acted on the request. Preserve ambiguity and escalate.
expected_evidence: Master TBD snapshot, exact target/firmware/system interface/tool/encoder and authoritative channel/medium/protocol/topology revision
Decoded tracking/auth/encryption/channel control byte, exact benign request fields, responder/session/address, checksum/PEC and peer approval
Pre-state routing/queue/log/BMC/target/non-target health, immediate confirmation, full raw 0x34 request and bridge completion with no-retry audit
Correlated responder response or authoritative consumer audit proving exact address/sequence/command/result, with protected raw and redacted review copy
Post-state target/non-target/queue/routing/alert/BMC health, preservation/containment evidence and independent engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop further sends and isolate the approved producer path. An already delivered message cannot be generically recalled. On timeout or uncertain bridge completion, do not resend; inspect the approved responder audit and, if applicable, perform only the pre-authorized single queue read to determine delivery. On unexpected target/action, preserve all routing/queue/log evidence, disable only the test fixture path through the owner-approved containment method and escalate to BMC/security/target owners. Do not clear queues/logs, send a compensating write, reset/power cycle or retry to force a clean result.

source_conflict.reason: The protected Master remains TBD, but standard 0x34 control bits, per-channel framing and bridge-versus-responder evidence semantics are complete. A single isolated responder/read-only request and Project security/topology binding provide deterministic acceptance without guessing OEM commands.

blocked.reason: Core Send Message semantics and safe read-only verification are authoritative. Exact channel/responder, protocol frame, security policy, health limits and response fixture are finite Project prerequisites under explicit approval and no-retry containment.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Exact active system interface, target channel/medium/protocol and non-broadcast responder; pinned encoder/parser; read-only request and expected result; tracking/auth/encryption policy; isolated consumer/queue evidence; health limits; approval and incident plan.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; REVIEW-LAYER HYBRID CASE ONLY; MASTER TBD PRESERVED; NO MESSAGE, CHANNEL, QUEUE, ROUTING, LOG, IPMI, RESET, POWER OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1
external_authorities.application: Sections 6.13.1 through 6.13.3 and 22.7, Tables 22-9/22-10 and Appendix G define App 0x34, tracking/security/channel bits, protocol-specific frames/completions, immediate bridge response and later correlated responder handling.

project_authority: The Project BMC/security owner selects the isolated responder, exact harmless read-only request, channel protocol, tracking/auth/encryption policy, health limits and response evidence path, and approves the one-shot external side effect. Vendor authority is required for OEM protocols or destinations; no Project parameter may legitimize broadcast, raw-send or an unreviewed state-changing payload.
